text: {"lessons":["My account’s short-term swings don’t show whether my approach will meet a ten-year goal, so I’ll judge decisions by a consistent long-term plan.","I added to Stock D after its price rose and bought other stocks at varying prices; I’ll check position sizes and avoid letting recent price moves dictate my allocation.","Selling Stock E at a gain felt rewarding, but a gain or loss alone doesn’t make a trade wise; I’ll decide to buy, sell, or hold based on my plan rather than recent performance."]}
